description: Explain which filters a Kleinanzeigen URL encodes, without scraping it. Returns the filters that map onto kleinanzeigen_search arguments plus any that do not — handy for telling the user what a link actually searches for, or for deciding whether kleinanzeigen_search is enough or kleinanzeigen_search_by_url is required. Makes no network request.

url.description: A kleinanzeigen.de search or category URL

name: kleinanzeigen_parse_search_url
title: Explain a Kleinanzeigen search URL
